job.job_description:
Gen AI LLM & RAG




Experience: 5-10 Years
Location: Hyderabad


Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Generative AI professional with strong hands-on experience in LLMs and RAG to build and deploy AI-powered solutions.




Key Responsibilities

Design and develop Generative AI solutions using LLMs.
Build and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
Work with LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector databases.
Develop scalable AI applications using Python.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise applications and data sources.
Implement document processing, chunking, embedding, retrieval, and response generation.
Evaluate and improve LLM/RAG performance, accuracy, and response quality.
Work on prompt optimization and LLM evaluation techniques.
Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, architects, and business teams.
Troubleshoot and optimize Gen AI applications for production use cases.



Required Skills

510 years of overall experience in AI/ML/Data Engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLMs.
Strong experience in RAG architecture and implementation.
Good knowledge of Python.
Experience with LLM frameworks/tools such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar.
Experience with Vector Databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or Azure AI Search.
Strong understanding of embeddings, semantic search, prompt engineering, and transformers.
Experience working with APIs for LLMs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or similar models.
Good understanding of ML/AI concepts and model evaluation.



Good to Have

Experience deploying Gen AI solutions on AWS/Azure/GCP.
Knowledge of MLOps/LLMOps and CI/CD.
Experience with fine-tuning or adapting LLMs.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices.
Experience building enterprise-grade Gen AI applications.

Location: Hyderabad
Experience: 510 Years
